verdict.rationale: Graphite documents automation that runs without manual intervention: AI review agent automatically reviews all new PRs once enabled (graphite-docs-18, graphite-docs-19) and a stack-aware merge queue that lands PRs in the background (graphite-docs-10), plus Agents that autonomously generate PRs from a prompt (graphite-docs-12). This is real background automation, but scoped narrowly to PR review/merge events rather than a general-purpose 'set up any automation' framework with custom triggers/scheduling. Missing for 10: evidence of configurable triggers/schedules beyond PR events, and independent/hands-on confirmation that these automations reliably run unattended over time.
